changelog: Renamed the app interface to NS Flow with the Continuous Ribbon logo, a white-and-teal wordmark, and a matching favicon.
Updated Help Center, update prompts, restart messages, and browser notices to use NS Flow.
Improved the compact navigation header to prevent the logo and account details from overlapping controls.
Fixed theme styling for Merge actions, Static Group confirmations, status pills, and disabled controls.
Static Group accepts record URLs with an extra slash and shows resolved ID + Name for added and already-present records.
Bulk Transfer updates today's Target Record date directly when the checkbox is already selected.
Completed Bulk Transfer batches can reapply changed guardrails after confirmation without reviewing the same records again.
